Source: https://github.com/lichess-org/mobile/tree/738fffd17510fbbf677ab51a2b2af478592af8df/assets/sounds/standard

move-lichess.aifc is the unchanged move.aifc used by Lichess Mobile on iOS.
move-lichess.mp3 is the unchanged move.mp3 used on its other platforms.
capture-lichess.aifc and capture-lichess.mp3 are the unchanged capture.aifc
and capture.mp3 used by Lichess Mobile on iOS and its other platforms.
The files are renamed for this app; their contents are unmodified.
Playback volume matches Lichess Mobile's default of 0.8.
Pinned URLs, file sizes and SHA-256 checksums are in lichess-source.json.
Verify or restore copies with tools/import-lichess-move-sound.py.
